notes:
**Two-tablet fix.** Switching the second tablet out of double mode and back in now reconnects properly. Before, it could end up only half connected: page turns on the second tablet never reached the first, and it kept snapping back to the first tablet's page.

**Tab order.** The screen has the new look, and the pen no longer draws on the page underneath it (which also stopped your finger working until you closed it).

**Tags.** The cursor starts in the search box and the keyboard comes up by itself, then goes away when you close the screen.

**Crop.** After "Apply to all pages" you go straight back to the reader, no need to tap Done.

If you use two tablets together, update both.
